Choose the video itself, and the holiday and birthday videos, under Videos.
Video (plays when the background is Video)
Birthday video (pick one, or Portal switches between them)
Kids who can choose their video (they can't search for more)
Manage apps (hold select on an app to hide or move it)
How much conversation your model can hold. Portal summarizes older messages before it fills.
Lets the AI look things up. Not offered to kid profiles. The AI can also open apps on its own.
Questions you ask are sent to this server. Any OpenAI-compatible address works, including one on your own network.
Severe alerts over apps (tornado and similar warnings)
Animated sky behind the weather page
From the home screen, and over other apps too when Also over other apps is on.
Follows the TV's volume. Silent overnight unless the night setting is Normal.
A reminder shows on the screen when it is due, whoever is using the TV and whatever is playing, with the name and picture of the profile that set it.
A reminder that came due while the TV was off
Extensions are separate apps that add tiles, settings and more to Portal. Nothing an extension asks for happens until you allow it here, one thing at a time.
Extensions are made by other people. Portal can't vouch for them, and they are not covered by its no-ads, no-tracking promise.
Don't ask for the PIN again for a while
Kids start with search off. With Apps + AI, the AI is told the user is a child and to keep answers age appropriate. That helps, but it isn't a guarantee.
Once a day Portal asks GitHub whether there is a newer version, and shows an Update button on the home screen if there is. It never downloads or installs anything by itself.
Restore the TV's own home screen
